name: LANDR
summary: Music platform offering AI mastering, distribution, samples, plugins and collaboration tools.
description: LANDR provides services for creating and releasing music: AI mastering online and as a DAW plugin, digital distribution to streaming services, a sample library, a plugin marketplace, collaboration and messaging tools, and courses. Musicians can also hire or sell services.

howToUse.title: Open LANDR
howToUse.description: Open LANDR and choose Sign up free.

howToUse.title: Master the track
howToUse.description: Master the music online in the browser, or run the LANDR Mastering Plugin inside your DAW.

howToUse.title: Distribute and pull in sounds
howToUse.description: Release the track through digital distribution to streaming services. While you produce, use the sample library and the plugin marketplace.

howToUse.title: Collaborate, study, or hire
howToUse.description: Use the collaboration and messaging tools, take a course, or hire or sell services with other musicians.
